metadata.title: Ableton Live 12.4.6 Suite - Boost.Python & LOM API Catalog

Live.Application.Application.docstring: This class represents the Live application.
Live.Application.Application.description: Top-level host application interface providing access to the open document, browser, view system, licensing, CPU meters, and native modal dialog automation.

open_dialog_count.doc: The number of open dialogs in Live. 0 if no dialog is open.

current_dialog_message.doc: Text of the last dialog that appeared; Empty if all dialogs just disappeared.

current_dialog_button_count.doc: Number of interactive buttons available on the currently active dialog.

average_process_usage.doc: Reports Live average CPU processing load (0.0 to 1.0+).

control_surfaces.doc: Const access to a list of control surfaces configured in Preferences.

unavailable_features.doc: List of features unavailable due to license tier (Intro/Standard/Suite).

browser.doc: Returns an interface to the Live asset database browser.

get_document.doc: Returns the active Live Set document instance.

get_version_string.doc: Returns the full version string of Live (e.g. '12.4.6').

has_option.doc: Returns True if entry exists in Options.txt, False otherwise.

press_current_dialog_button.doc: Presses a button, by index, on the current open modal dialog.

Live.Application.Application.View.docstring: This class represents the view aspects of the Live application.
Live.Application.Application.View.description: Application view manager for switching main views, toggling browser/hot swap, and inspecting view component visibility.

available_main_views.doc: List of available main view identifiers: ['Session', 'Arranger'].

focused_document_view.doc: Identifier of the currently focused document view ('Session' or 'Arranger').

browse_mode.doc: True if HotSwap browse mode is active.

focus_view.doc: Focuses and brings view to front ('Session', 'Arranger', 'Detail', 'Detail/Clip', 'Detail/DeviceChain', 'Browser').

hide_view.doc: Hides or collapses specified view component.

scroll_view.doc: Scrolls focused view (left, right, up, down).

toggle_browse.doc: Reveals device chain and toggles hot-swap mode for selected device.

is_view_visible.doc: Returns True if specified view identifier is currently visible.

Live.Song.Song.docstring: This class represents a Live set.
Live.Song.Song.description: Central project container governing playback transport, tracks, scenes, arrangement loop, tempo, time signature, project scale, microtonal tuning, and MIDI capture.

punch_in.doc: Punch-in recording flag at loop start.

punch_out.doc: Punch-out recording flag at loop end.

back_to_arranger.doc: Return playback from Session clips to Arrangement.

scale_information.doc: Semitone interval offsets from root note.

can_capture_midi.doc: True if unrecorded MIDI is in buffer.

can_undo.doc: True if undo action is available.

can_redo.doc: True if redo action is available.

tracks.doc: List of audio and MIDI tracks.

visible_tracks.doc: List of tracks not hidden inside collapsed group tracks.

groove_amount.doc: Global groove pool timing amount applied to song (0.0 to 1.0).

start_playing.doc: Starts playback at current song time.

jump_by.doc: Jumps playhead forward/backward by specified beats.

create_audio_track.doc: Creates new audio track at index.

create_midi_track.doc: Creates new MIDI track at index.

capture_midi.doc: Captures unrecorded MIDI buffer into clip.

get_all_scales_ordered.doc: Returns ordered list of all supported project scales.

tap_tempo.doc: Taps tempo following user tap interval timing.

jump_to_next_cue.doc: Jumps playhead to the next locator cue point in Arrangement view.

jump_to_prev_cue.doc: Jumps playhead to the previous locator cue point in Arrangement view.

set_or_delete_cue.doc: Sets a new locator cue point at the current song time, or deletes the cue point if one exists.

duplicate_scene.doc: Duplicates the scene at the specified index.

Live.Track.Track.docstring: This class represents a track in Live. It can be either an Audio track, a MIDI Track, a Return Track, or the Master Track.
Live.Track.Track.description: Track object containing clip slots, arrangement clips, take lanes, device chains, routing, and mixer controls.

name.doc: Track header display name.

can_be_armed.doc: True if track supports recording arm.

is_grouped.doc: True if track resides inside a group track.

mixer_device.doc: Volume, pan, and send mixer device.

create_take_lane.doc: Creates and returns a new arrangement take lane on this track.

duplicate_clip_slot.doc: Duplicates clip slot to adjacent slot.

duplicate_clip_to_arrangement.doc: Copies clip to arrangement timeline at destination beat.

stop_all_clips.doc: Stops all playing clips on this track.

Live.TakeLane.TakeLane.docstring: Represents an arrangement take lane on an audio or MIDI track in Live 12.
Live.TakeLane.TakeLane.description: Live 12 TakeLane API enabling non-destructive comping, programmatic take management, and per-lane clip creation in the Arrangement view.

name.doc: Name of the take lane.

arrangement_clips.doc: Read-only access to the arrangement clips in the take lane.

canonical_parent.doc: Track that owns this take lane.

create_audio_clip.doc: Creates an audio clip referencing the file at the given path and inserts it into the arrangement at the specified time. Throws an error when called on a non-audio or a frozen track, when the specified time is outside the [0., 1576800.] range, when the track is currently being recorded into, or when the path doesn't point to a valid audio file.

create_midi_clip.doc: Creates an empty MIDI clip and inserts it into the arrangement at the specified time. Throws an error when called on a non-MIDI track or a frozen track, when the specified time is outside the [0., 1576800.] range, or when the track is currently being recorded into.

get_data.doc: Retrieves custom key-value data persistently stored with the take lane in the Live Set.

set_data.doc: Persists custom key-value metadata with the take lane into the Live Set.

Live.ClipSlot.ClipSlot.docstring: This class represents an entry in Lives Session view matrix.
Live.ClipSlot.ClipSlot.description: Matrix cell in the Session View capable of hosting, triggering, or creating a Session clip.

has_clip.doc: True if slot contains a clip.

is_group_slot.doc: True if slot resides on a group track.

is_playing.doc: True if clip in slot is currently playing.

is_triggered.doc: True if clip slot launch is queued.

create_clip.doc: Creates an empty MIDI clip of specified beat length in this slot.

create_audio_clip.doc: Creates an audio clip referencing file path in this slot.

delete_clip.doc: Deletes clip residing in this slot.

fire.doc: Fires clip slot according to launch quantization.

stop.doc: Stops playback of clip in this slot.

Live.Clip.Clip.docstring: This class represents a Clip in Live. It can be either an Audio Clip or a MIDI Clip, in an Arrangement or the Session, depending on the Track (Slot) it lives in.
Live.Clip.Clip.description: Audio and MIDI container supporting Live 12 extended MIDI notes (probability, velocity_deviation, note_id), audio warp markers, pitch transpose, looping, and envelopes.

name.doc: Display label.

is_take_lane_clip.doc: Live 12: True if clip resides in a take lane.

start_time.doc: Timeline start position in beats for Arrangement clips.

warping.doc: Enables audio tempo warping (audio clips only).

warp_mode.doc: Selected warp mode (beats, tones, texture, repitch, complex, complex_pro, rex).

available_warp_modes.doc: Tuple of available warp modes for this audio clip.

file_path.doc: Absolute filesystem path to referenced audio file (audio clips only).

position.doc: Current playback head position in beats.

playing_position.doc: Real-time playhead position in beats (updated during playback).

is_playing.doc: True if the clip is currently actively outputting audio or MIDI.

is_recording.doc: True if the clip is actively recording input.

is_overdubbing.doc: True if MIDI overdub is actively writing notes to the clip.

is_triggered.doc: True if the clip has received a launch trigger and is waiting for quantization.

launch_mode.doc: Launch mode: trigger (0), gate (1), toggle (2), repeat (3).

signature_numerator.doc: Time signature numerator for this clip.

signature_denominator.doc: Time signature denominator for this clip.

ram_mode.doc: True if sample is loaded entirely into RAM.

sample_length.doc: Raw audio sample duration in sample frames.

sample_rate.doc: Audio sample sample rate in Hz.

start_marker.doc: Sample/clip start marker position in beats.

end_marker.doc: Sample/clip end marker position in beats.

groove.doc: The groove object applied to this clip.

has_groove.doc: True if a groove is assigned to the clip.

has_envelopes.doc: True if the clip contains any parameter automation envelopes.

get_notes_extended.doc: Returns a list of MIDI notes from the given pitch and time range. Each note is represented by a Live.Clip.MidiNote object.

get_selected_notes_extended.doc: Returns a list of all MIDI notes from the clip that are currently selected. Each note is represented by a Live.Clip.MidiNote object.

get_all_notes_extended.doc: Returns a list of all MIDI notes from the clip, regardless of position relative to loop markers.

get_notes_by_id.doc: Return a list of MIDI notes matching the given note IDs.

add_new_notes.doc: Expects a Python iterable holding Live.Clip.MidiNoteSpecification objects to construct new notes in the clip.

apply_note_modifications.doc: Expects a list of notes matching note IDs. Modifies existing notes while preserving per-note MPE expressions.

duplicate_notes_by_id.doc: Duplicates specified note IDs to destination time with semitone transposition.

remove_notes_extended.doc: Delete all notes starting in the given pitch and time range.

remove_notes_by_id.doc: Delete all notes matching the given note IDs.

select_all_notes.doc: Selects all notes in the clip.

deselect_all_notes.doc: Deselects all notes in the clip.

quantize.doc: Quantizes notes or audio warp markers.

quantize_pitch.doc: Quantizes notes of a specific pitch.

note_number_to_name.doc: Return human-readable name for pitch number, respecting Set scale and tuning system.

add_warp_marker.doc: Inserts warp marker at beat position in audio clip.

fire.doc: Launches the clip according to its launch quantization.

stop.doc: Stops playback of the clip according to track/global launch quantization.

crop.doc: Crops the clip to its loop boundaries.

duplicate_loop.doc: Duplicates the active loop section and doubles clip length.

clear_all_envelopes.doc: Removes all automation envelopes from the clip.

clear_envelope.doc: Removes the automation envelope for the specified device parameter.

Live.Clip.MidiNote.docstring: An object representing a MIDI Note in Live 12.
Live.Clip.MidiNote.description: Represents an individual MIDI note retrieved from Live 12 extended note queries. Encapsulates note identity, probability, velocity humanization, and release velocity.

note_id.doc: Unique numerical note ID within originating clip. Required for apply_note_modifications.

velocity_deviation.doc: Live 12: Velocity deviation range [-127.0..127.0] for humanization randomization.

Live.Clip.MidiNoteSpecification.docstring: An object specifying the data for creating a MIDI note. To be used with the add_new_notes function.
Live.Clip.MidiNoteSpecification.description: Specification object used to instantiate new notes via Clip.add_new_notes(). Only pitch, start_time, and duration are mandatory.

Live.TuningSystem.TuningSystem.docstring: Represents a Tuning System and its properties in Live 12.
Live.TuningSystem.TuningSystem.description: Microtonal tuning system loaded into the Live Set, providing microtonal frequency calculations, step definitions, and cents offsets.

name.doc: Name of currently active tuning system.

number_of_notes_in_pseudo_octave.doc: Number of pitch classes per pseudo-octave cycle.

pseudo_octave_in_cents.doc: Width of octave cycle in cents (1200.0 for standard 12-TET).

note_tunings.doc: Cents deviation offsets for each step in pseudo-octave.

Live.Browser.Browser.docstring: This class represents the live browser data base.
Live.Browser.Browser.description: Sound library and asset database. Exposes categorical root items (sounds, drums, instruments, effects, packs, plugins) and provides item loading and previewing.

max_for_live.doc: Max for Live devices category root.

load_item.doc: Loads browser item into currently selected track, chain, or pad.

preview_item.doc: Starts auditioning audio preview of browser item.

relation_to_hotswap_target.doc: Evaluates relationship between item and active hotswap device.

Live.Device.Device.docstring: This class represents a MIDI or Audio DSP-Device in Live.
Live.Device.Device.description: Base DSP device containing parameters, on/off activator, A/B comparison preset slots, and view state.

name.doc: Device instance header name.

can_compare_ab.doc: True if device supports A/B preset comparison.

save_preset_to_compare_ab_slot.doc: Stores active parameters to secondary A/B slot.

Live.DeviceParameter.DeviceParameter.docstring: This class represents a (automatable) parameter within a MIDI or Audio DSP-Device.
Live.DeviceParameter.DeviceParameter.description: DSP parameter with automation envelopes, value item strings, gesture demarcation, and listener support.

name.doc: Current parameter name.

display_value.doc: Formatted string with units (e.g. '12.0 kHz', '-6.0 dB').

is_enabled.doc: True if parameter is currently active.

value_items.doc: Enumerated display labels for quantized parameters.

begin_gesture.doc: Demarcates beginning of user parameter manipulation for automation recording.

re_enable_automation.doc: Re-enables overridden automation for this parameter.

Live.RackDevice.RackDevice.docstring: Represents an Audio Effect Rack, MIDI Effect Rack, Instrument Rack, or Drum Rack device.
Live.RackDevice.RackDevice.description: Multi-chain container device supporting macro controls, macro variations, dynamic macro count, and drum pad routing.

canonical_parent.doc: Track or Chain that owns this device instance.

name.doc: User-editable display name of this Rack Device device instance.

class_display_name.doc: Canonical UI name of the device type ('Rack Device').

parameters.doc: Tuple of all controllable automation parameters.

can_have_chains.doc: Whether the device can contain nested chains.

can_have_drum_pads.doc: Whether the device can host drum pads.

latency_in_ms.doc: Latency introduced by internal processing in milliseconds.

latency_in_samples.doc: Latency introduced by internal processing in sample units.

chains.doc: Tuple of audio or MIDI chains contained in this rack.

drum_pads.doc: Tuple of all 128 drum pads (present on Drum Racks).

visible_drum_pads.doc: Tuple of visible drum pads in the drum pad matrix view.

has_drum_pads.doc: True if this rack is a Drum Rack.

has_macro_mappings.doc: True if at least one macro is mapped to a downstream parameter.

chain_selector.doc: Parameter controlling chain selector zone routing.

is_showing_chains.doc: Whether the chain list view is visible in the GUI.

can_show_chains.doc: Whether this rack supports chain list view display.

selected_variation_index.doc: Zero-based index of the currently selected macro variation.

visible_macro_count.doc: Number of visible macro knobs (1 to 16).

store_variation.doc: Stores current macro parameter states as a new macro variation.

recall_selected_variation.doc: Recalls macro parameter states from the variation at selected_variation_index.

delete_selected_variation.doc: Deletes the macro variation at selected_variation_index.

recall_last_used_variation.doc: Recalls the most recently used macro variation.

randomize_macros.doc: Randomizes all mapped macro knob parameter values.

copy_pad.doc: Copies drum pad configuration and nested devices from source MIDI pitch to destination MIDI pitch.

insert_chain.doc: Inserts a new chain at the specified index (-1 appends to the end).

Live.WavetableDevice.WavetableDevice.docstring: This class represents a Wavetable device.
Live.WavetableDevice.WavetableDevice.description: Advanced Wavetable synthesizer featuring dual wavetable oscillators, unison modes, and a programmatic modulation matrix API.

visible_modulation_target_names.doc: Names of visible modulation targets in matrix.

oscillator_1_effect_mode.doc: Oscillator 1 effect mode (none, fm, classic, modern).

is_parameter_modulatable.doc: Returns True if parameter can be modulated.

add_parameter_to_modulation_matrix.doc: Adds parameter to modulation matrix targets.

get_modulation_value.doc: Gets modulation intensity between source and target.

set_modulation_value.doc: Sets modulation amount for source-target connection.

get_modulation_target_parameter_name.doc: Retrieves parameter name at target index.

Live.MeldDevice.MeldDevice.docstring: This class represents a Meld device.
Live.MeldDevice.MeldDevice.description: Live 12 bi-timbral macro synthesizer featuring dual independent sound engines (Engine A and Engine B), cross-modulation, and extensive macro controls.

Live.RoarDevice.RoarDevice.docstring: This class represents a Roar device.
Live.RoarDevice.RoarDevice.description: Live 12 multi-stage saturation and coloration audio effect with flexible routing stages and envelope follower auditioning.

Live.DriftDevice.DriftDevice.docstring: This class represents a Drift device.
Live.DriftDevice.DriftDevice.description: Ableton Live 12 Drift analog-subtractive synthesizer device with voice modes, independent stereo filter modulation, and flexible modulation matrix routing.

canonical_parent.doc: Track or Chain that owns this device instance.

name.doc: User-editable display name of this Drift device instance.

class_display_name.doc: Canonical UI name of the device type ('Drift').

parameters.doc: Tuple of all controllable automation parameters.

can_have_chains.doc: Whether the device can contain nested chains.

can_have_drum_pads.doc: Whether the device can host drum pads.

latency_in_ms.doc: Latency introduced by internal processing in milliseconds.

latency_in_samples.doc: Latency introduced by internal processing in sample units.

view.doc: GUI view controls for the device.

voice_mode_list.doc: Return the voice mode list (Poly, Mono, Stereo, Legato).

mod_matrix_shape_source_list.doc: Return the shape mod source list.

mod_matrix_shape_source_index.doc: Return the shape mod source index.

mod_matrix_lfo_source_list.doc: Return the lfo mod source list.

mod_matrix_lfo_source_index.doc: Return the lfo mod source index.

mod_matrix_filter_source_1_list.doc: Return the filter mod source 1 list.

mod_matrix_filter_source_1_index.doc: Return the filter mod source 1 index.

mod_matrix_filter_source_2_list.doc: Return the filter mod source 2 list.

mod_matrix_filter_source_2_index.doc: Return the filter mod source 2 index.

mod_matrix_pitch_source_1_list.doc: Return the pitch mod source 1 list.

mod_matrix_pitch_source_1_index.doc: Return the pitch mod source 1 index.

mod_matrix_pitch_source_2_list.doc: Return the pitch mod source 2 list.

mod_matrix_pitch_source_2_index.doc: Return the pitch mod source 2 index.

mod_matrix_source_1_list.doc: Return the custom mod source 1 list.

mod_matrix_source_1_index.doc: Return the custom mod source 1 index.

mod_matrix_source_2_list.doc: Return the custom mod source 2 list.

mod_matrix_source_2_index.doc: Return the custom mod source 2 index.

mod_matrix_source_3_list.doc: Return the custom mod source 3 list.

mod_matrix_source_3_index.doc: Return the custom mod source 3 index.

mod_matrix_target_1_list.doc: Return the custom mod target 1 list.

mod_matrix_target_1_index.doc: Return the custom mod target 1 index.

mod_matrix_target_2_list.doc: Return the custom mod target 2 list.

mod_matrix_target_2_index.doc: Return the custom mod target 2 index.

mod_matrix_target_3_list.doc: Return the custom mod target 3 list.

mod_matrix_target_3_index.doc: Return the custom mod target 3 index.

pitch_bend_range.doc: Return the Pitch Bend Range in semitones.

Live.CcControlDevice.CcControlDevice.docstring: This class represents a CcControl device.
Live.CcControlDevice.CcControlDevice.description: Ableton Live 12 MIDI effect device for transmitting customizable continuous controllers, program changes, and boolean CC messages to external MIDI hardware and plug-ins.

canonical_parent.doc: Track or Chain that owns this device instance.

name.doc: User-editable display name of this CC Control device instance.

class_display_name.doc: Canonical UI name of the device type ('CC Control').

parameters.doc: Tuple of all controllable automation parameters.

can_have_chains.doc: Whether the device can contain nested chains.

can_have_drum_pads.doc: Whether the device can host drum pads.

latency_in_ms.doc: Latency introduced by internal processing in milliseconds.

latency_in_samples.doc: Latency introduced by internal processing in sample units.

view.doc: GUI view controls for the device.

custom_bool_target_list.doc: Return the custom bool target list.

custom_bool_target.doc: Return the custom bool target CC index.

custom_float_target_0_list.doc: Return the custom float target 0 list.

custom_float_target_0.doc: Return the custom float target 0 CC index.

custom_float_target_1_list.doc: Return the custom float target 1 list.

custom_float_target_1.doc: Return the custom float target 1 CC index.

custom_float_target_2_list.doc: Return the custom float target 2 list.

custom_float_target_2.doc: Return the custom float target 2 CC index.

custom_float_target_3_list.doc: Return the custom float target 3 list.

custom_float_target_3.doc: Return the custom float target 3 CC index.

custom_float_target_4_list.doc: Return the custom float target 4 list.

custom_float_target_4.doc: Return the custom float target 4 CC index.

custom_float_target_5_list.doc: Return the custom float target 5 list.

custom_float_target_5.doc: Return the custom float target 5 CC index.

custom_float_target_6_list.doc: Return the custom float target 6 list.

custom_float_target_6.doc: Return the custom float target 6 CC index.

custom_float_target_7_list.doc: Return the custom float target 7 list.

custom_float_target_7.doc: Return the custom float target 7 CC index.

custom_float_target_8_list.doc: Return the custom float target 8 list.

custom_float_target_8.doc: Return the custom float target 8 CC index.

custom_float_target_9_list.doc: Return the custom float target 9 list.

custom_float_target_9.doc: Return the custom float target 9 CC index.

custom_float_target_10_list.doc: Return the custom float target 10 list.

custom_float_target_10.doc: Return the custom float target 10 CC index.

custom_float_target_11_list.doc: Return the custom float target 11 list.

custom_float_target_11.doc: Return the custom float target 11 CC index.

resend.doc: Resend all CC values to output.

Live.SimplerDevice.SimplerDevice.docstring: This class represents a Simpler device in Live.
Live.SimplerDevice.SimplerDevice.description: Ableton Simpler sampling instrument device, supporting sample replacement, playback slicing, warping, and multi-sample parts.

canonical_parent.doc: Track or Chain that owns this device instance.

name.doc: User-editable display name of this Simpler device instance.

class_display_name.doc: Canonical UI name of the device type ('Simpler').

parameters.doc: Tuple of all controllable automation parameters.

can_have_chains.doc: Whether the device can contain nested chains.

can_have_drum_pads.doc: Whether the device can host drum pads.

latency_in_ms.doc: Latency introduced by internal processing in milliseconds.

latency_in_samples.doc: Latency introduced by internal processing in sample units.

sample.doc: Reference to the loaded sample object.

playing_position.doc: Current playback position within the sample in seconds.

playing_position_enabled.doc: Enables real-time tracking of playing position.

multi_sample_mode.doc: Whether Simpler is in multi-sample mode.

slicing_playback_mode.doc: Playback mode for slices: Mono (0), Poly (1), Through (2).

retrigger.doc: Retrigger sample playback on note on.

can_warp_as.doc: Whether warp_as can currently be executed on the loaded sample.

can_warp_double.doc: Whether warp_double can currently be executed on the loaded sample.

can_warp_half.doc: Whether warp_half can currently be executed on the loaded sample.

replace_sample.doc: Replaces the loaded samples with the one at the provided path.

crop.doc: Crops the loaded sample to the current start and end marker bounds.

reverse.doc: Reverses the audio sample in memory.

guess_playback_length.doc: Analyzes the sample and guesses the optimal playback length.

warp_as.doc: Warps the sample to a specified target length in beats.

warp_double.doc: Doubles the warp tempo (halves playback speed).

warp_half.doc: Halves the warp tempo (doubles playback speed).

Live.Chain.Chain.docstring: This class represents a group device chain in Live.
Live.Chain.Chain.description: Individual branch within an Audio, MIDI, or Instrument Rack holding its own sub-device chain and mixer.

name.doc: Chain display name.

mixer_device.doc: Chain volume, pan, and send mixer.

Live.DrumPad.DrumPad.docstring: This class represents a drum group device pad in Live.
Live.DrumPad.DrumPad.description: Individual pad in a Drum Rack assigned to a MIDI note [0..127].

name.doc: Pad header label.

delete_all_chains.doc: Deletes all chains associated with this pad.

Live.Scene.Scene.docstring: This class represents an series of ClipSlots in Lives Sessionview matrix.
Live.Scene.Scene.description: Horizontal row across all tracks in the Session View, capable of launching all clips simultaneously.

name.doc: Scene label.

tempo.doc: Tempo override in BPM if defined.

time_signature_enabled.doc: True if scene launch overrides project time signature.

tempo_enabled.doc: True if scene launch overrides project tempo.

fire.doc: Fires scene according to launch quantization.

Live.Base.Timer.docstring: A timer that will trigger a callback after a certain inverval. The timer can be repeated and will trigger the callback every interval. Errors in the callback will stop the timer.
Live.Base.Timer.description: High-frequency C++ timer embedded in Live's main event loop. Crucial for scheduling asynchronous RPC bridge queue dispatches at 5ms intervals on the main thread.

restart.doc: Restarts timer from zero elapsed time.

Live.SpectralResonatorDevice.SpectralRes.docstring: This class represents a Spectral Resonator device.
Live.SpectralResonatorDevice.SpectralRes.description: Live 12 Spectral Resonator audio effect device with spectral processing, polyphonic MIDI sidechain resonator modes, and tuning controls.

canonical_parent.doc: Track or Chain that owns this device instance.

name.doc: User-editable display name of this Spectral Resonator device instance.

class_display_name.doc: Canonical UI name of the device type ('Spectral Resonator').

parameters.doc: Tuple of all controllable automation parameters.

can_have_chains.doc: Whether the device can contain nested chains.

can_have_drum_pads.doc: Whether the device can host drum pads.

latency_in_ms.doc: Latency introduced by internal processing in milliseconds.

latency_in_samples.doc: Latency introduced by internal processing in sample units.

view.doc: GUI view controls for the device.

frequency_dial_mode_list.doc: Return the current frequency dial mode list (e.g. ['hz', 'note']).

frequency_dial_mode.doc: Return the current frequency dial mode index.

midi_gate_list.doc: Return the current midi gate list.

midi_gate.doc: Return the current midi gate index.

mod_mode_list.doc: Return the current mod mode list (e.g. ['chorus', 'wander', 'granular']).

mod_mode.doc: Return the current mod mode index.

mono_poly_list.doc: Return the current mono poly mode list (e.g. ['mono', 'poly']).

mono_poly.doc: Return the current mono poly mode index.

pitch_mode.doc: Return the current pitch bend range setting.

Live.MixerDevice.MixerDevice.docstring: This class represents a Mixer Device in Live, which gives you access to the Volume and Panning properties of a Track.
Live.MixerDevice.MixerDevice.description: Mixer component governing track volume, stereo balance panning, send return amounts, crossfader assignment, and monitoring split.

Live.GroovePool.GroovePool.docstring: This class represents the groove pool in Live.
Live.GroovePool.GroovePool.description: Project-wide repository containing timing and velocity swing templates applicable to clips.

grooves.doc: Collection of grooves loaded into the pool.

Live.Sample.Sample.docstring: This class represents a sample file loaded into a Simpler instance.
Live.Sample.Sample.description: Underlying audio waveform asset loaded in Simpler, providing sample bounds, warping, transient detection markers, and slicing.

file_path.doc: Filesystem path to source audio sample.

slices.doc: Sample slice boundary markers in samples.

warping.doc: Whether sample warping engine is active.

slicing_style.doc: Slicing algorithm: transient (0), beat (1), region (2), manual (3).

slicing_beat_grid.doc: Beat division grid used when slicing_style is beat.

slicing_region_count.doc: Number of equal divisions when slicing_style is region.

slicing_beat_division.doc: Grid resolution when slicing by beat division.

insert_slice.doc: Inserts manual slice marker at sample index.

Live.MaxDevice.MaxDevice.docstring: This class represents a Max for Live device.
Live.MaxDevice.MaxDevice.description: Max for Live interactive patch container with dynamic parameter mapping and direct LOM integration.
